test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 18 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: O, P, Q, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). P sits second to the left of T. S sits third to the right of Q. Q is not an immediate neighbour of P. O sits second to the right of S. Which of the following represents the position of O with respect of R?
solution:
Given, O, P, Q, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

S sits third to the right of Q.

O sits second to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f9733db69cc9547f4836f019ea479682005a7cfa737f7752bd86be6273484b3.png] 

Q is not an immediate neighbour of P.

P sits second to the left of T.

R sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1819895df39f3c8426461b87267593647ff60ab5e4ace79cde4b33e83034d9b.png] 

So, the position of O is Second to the left of R.

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
